purpose: Reproduce and close a bounded ACIS 700 zero-record-count framing refusal in an AC1024 DWG, without claiming SAT conversion or 3D semantic support.

sat.provenance: Public cube SAT sample. The downloaded SAT remained under /tmp and was not committed as a fixture.

generatedDxf.operation: Created a 3DSOLID and assigned the SAT 700 lines to its SAT carrier.

extractor.integrityScope: The generated DWG has other reader integrity warnings; this receipt qualifies only the extracted modeler payload and parser framing behavior.

files.src/drw_acis.cpp: Admits a zero ACIS record count as unknown for version 700 only, matching the existing version-scoped 21200/21500/21800 behavior. Completion still requires the explicit terminal marker and full input consumption.
files.tests/acis_sat_allocation_tests.cpp: Adds an in-memory, locally generated ACIS 700 zero-count body/terminal vector and verifies complete parsing plus missing-terminal refusal. No external DWG/DXF/SAT fixture was added.

implementation.scopeLimit: No 700 SAT v1 serialization, DXF/DWG output admission, native acceptance, or semantic support claim is added.

beforeChange.operation: drw_parseSabWithOutcome on the exact extracted payload
beforeChange.result: Rejected after 115 record starts and 1211 tags because header recordCount=0 was treated as a literal count.

afterChange.operation: drw_parseSabWithOutcome, drw_buildAcisModel, drw_extractAcisWireframeWithReport on the exact extracted payload

generatedControl.result: PASS 1/1; generated complete terminal case and missing-terminal refusal both verified.

authorityBoundary.use: ODA describes DWG release-to-default SAT/SAB version mappings and the Autodesk-modified dialect boundary. The sample experiment is an ODA converter output observation only; it does not establish Autodesk producer behavior or resolve the separate ACIS 21500 header semantics.
authorityBoundary.semanticCeiling: Framing plus structural inventory from one ODA-produced carrier. No independent semantic oracle, B-rep kernel, native acceptance, carrier writer, or producer-wide version profile is established.

claimEffect: Closes the parser's bounded ACIS 700 zero-count framing refusal for streams with an explicit terminal marker. Does not promote DWG, DXF, ACIS/ACDS, or 3D support claims.
